shots.focal_element: Apollo People Search UI, first with oversized blue stat overlays (281.1M / 70M), then the expanded filter grid, a LinkedIn profile with the Apollo Chrome extension, a saved-list table and a sequence editor
on_screen_text: Start your people search by applying any filter in the left panel
The fastest growing, most loved sales technology on Earth.
shots.typography: Overlay stats: very large geometric sans, medium/semibold weight, numerals plus uppercase M, tight tracking, set in a saturated blue directly over the faded UI; all other text is native product UI sans (small, regular weight, sentence case). Font guess (low confidence): Inter-like.
shots.what_happens: A long continuous cursor-guided product walkthrough synced to the VO (w65-w157). Opens on the People Search page (the corner of a brand-yellow disc is visible at 0:19.5, suggesting a shape wipe in); the cursor hovers the Total tab and the UI fades back while a giant '281.1M' appears, then a second number counts up 33M -> 67M -> 70M on 'over 280 million people and 70 million companies' (w75-w82), then both fade out. On 'dozens of advanced filters' (w88-w91) More Filters opens a multi-column filter grid, the view pushes in, the cursor hovers Job Change and Technologies (w94-w97) and expands Buying Intent with High/Medium/Low/None options (w111-w113). On the Chrome-extension line (w117-w134) a slightly tilted, shadowed LinkedIn profile window slides up over the app, scales to fill frame, and the Apollo extension side panel opens with contact details. Around w135-w139 the LinkedIn window shrinks and slides away to reveal a list table where rows are checked and Save is clicked; a yellow circular wipe (about 0:49.5-0:50.0) then leads into the sequence editor (w150-w156), which pushes in and the cursor clicks 'Add a step'. Visible zoom/push-ins and window scale moves happen within the shot; exact easing not visible from 2 fps sheets.
shots.build_rebuild: Record the product UI at high resolution, then in the editor animate a camera (scale/translate) over the recording per VO phrase, dim the UI to ~40% opacity and overlay large blue sans numerals that fade in and count up (0 -> 70M) on the spoken stats, and composite separately recorded windows (LinkedIn page) as shadowed cards that slide up, scale to full frame and shrink away, joining sections with a brand-yellow circle wipe.

shots.focal_element: Right-hand step-picker card listing Phone call, Action item and LinkedIn tasks over the dimmed sequence editor, with the cursor on the 'Add a step' button
shots.typography: Native product UI: medium-weight sans titles in sentence case with smaller regular grey descriptions beneath; no added motion-graphics type.
shots.what_happens: A half-second (one sampled frame) tight crop showing the moment after 'Add a step' is clicked: the background sequence dims and the step-picker list appears at the right edge, cropped by the zoom, on 'emails,' (w158). It reads as the zoomed-in start of a camera move that continues in s005->s006; detail beyond the single frame is not visible.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a ~0.5 s 1.6x-scaled crop of the recording anchored on the clicked button, with a dark overlay on the page and the white step-picker panel entering at the right, then pull the camera back in the next shot.

shots.focal_element: Centered 'Select a sequence step' modal listing Automatic email, Manual email, Phone call, Action item and LinkedIn task step types
shots.transition_other: Camera pull-back/re-frame from the s005 close-up to the full centered modal (frame at 0:52.5 is mid-move, modal partially off-centre)
on_screen_text: Add a step for the sequence to follow and automate for you.
shots.typography: Native product UI: modal title in semibold sans, sentence case; list items medium weight with small grey descriptions; purple 'AI available!' pill badges with sparkle icon.
shots.what_happens: The view settles on the full modal centered over the dimmed sequence page while the VO lists 'phone calls, and LinkedIn touches' (w159-w163); the cursor glides down the list hovering Automatic email, Phone call/Action item and LinkedIn: send connection request in step with the spoken channels, then moves to the close X; at about 0:57.0 the modal is gone and the full sequence overview is visible as 'You can also utilize' (w164-w166) begins.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the modal centered with the page behind dimmed (black overlay ~50%), and script the cursor to hover each step type exactly on the matching VO word before closing the modal into the next section.
